a: maithuna a. (nī f.) [mithupena nirvṛttaṃ aṇ] 1 Paired, coupled. 2 United by marriage. 3 Relating to copula tion. — naṃ 1 Copulation, sexual union; mṛtaṃ maithunamaprajaṃ Pt. 2. 94. 2 Marriage. 3 Union, connection. 4 Consecrating the fire (agnyādhāna). Comp. — jvaraḥ the excitement of sexual passion. — dharmin a. copulating. — vairāgyaṃ abstinence from sexual intercourse.

a: maitra a. (trī f.) [mitra-aṇ] 1 Belonging to a friend. 2 Given by a friend. 3 Friendly, well-disposed, amicable, kind; Ms. 2. 87; Bg. 12. 13. 4 Relating to the god Mitra (as a Muhūrta); Ku. 7. 6. — traḥ 1 A high or perfect Brāhmaṇa. 2 N. of a particular mixed tribe; Ms. 10. 23. 3 The anus. 4 A friend. — trī 1 Friendship, good will. 2 Intimate connection or association, union, contact; pratyūṣeṣu sphuṭitakatalāmodamaitrīkaṣāyaḥ Me. 31. 3 The lupar mansion called anurādhā. — traṃ 1 Friendship. 2 Voiding or evacuation of excrement; Ms. 4. 152. 3 A prayer addressed to Mitra. 4 The lunar mansion anurādhā (maitrabhaṃ) in the same sense.
